verses.english: “For insight into greed, five things should be developed.

verses.pali: Asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā—
verses.english: The perceptions of ugliness, death, drawbacks, repulsiveness of food, and dissatisfaction with the whole world.

verses.pali: rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: For insight into greed, these five things should be developed.”
